text:
tara: Heads-up: a developer ran an s3 sync to gs://service-debug-uploads/2026-10-09/host-3.tar.gz and it contains a VAULT_TOKEN and an SA JSON. Escalating P0 for rotation. :rotating_light:

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-999 created and oncall paged.

ben: Can you paste a masked grep so we can scope quickly (no raw creds)?

tara: Masked snippet below:

```
VAULT_TOKEN=***vault-zzzz***
GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/tmp/debug-sa.json
{"type":"service_account","project_id":"redwood-service","private_key_id":"***","private_key":"-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\n***\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----"}
```

tara: Bucket lifecycle was 30d and ACL allowed org-editors (includes a contractor).

oliver: Quick playbook: 1) Revoke VAULT token accessor + revoke leases. 2) Delete SA key, create new key with minimal roles scoped to debug bucket. 3) Rewrap any artifacts encrypted with transit-KMS used by that SA; schedule transit rekey if used. 4) Narrow IAM for debug SA (no storage.admin). 5) Set bucket TTL to 24h, enable uniform access & object logs. 6) Turn on Vault audit JSON sink for 7d and export to central logging.

ops-oncall: Running containment now. Command snippets (masked):

```
vault token-revoke -accessor "***accessor***"
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEYID --iam-account=debug-uploader@redwood-service.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-service
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-debug-key.json --iam-account=debug-uploader@redwood-service.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-service
```

ops-oncall: Done. Old key deleted, new key created and stored at secret/debug/new-key with 1h TTL. Vault token revoked.

ben: I'll run Vault + GCP audit queries for 48h to check token usage and any reads under secret/data/prod-*.

tara: Early triage: Vault audit shows token-lookup activity and a KV read at secret/data/staging/feature-toggle (non-prod). GCP shows SA PUT to the bucket at 2026-10-09T02:11Z. No prod reads so far.

oliver: Rewrap job queued for transit-KMS-21 -> transit-KMS-22; will run in 20m and file a follow-up to rotate transit-KMS-21 after maintenance. Also adding deny rule so debug-uploader SA cannot access prod buckets.

ben: Opening an RBAC PR to remove broad storage roles from debug-uploader and grant objectCreator + objects.get scoped to gs://service-debug-uploads only. Will request expedited review.

ops-oncall: RBAC patch applied in prod after review; bucket lifecycle set to 24h and uniform access enforced. Object access logs enabled and forwarded to central logs.

ben: Audit findings: no prod secret reads. Two denied list attempts from an external IP were logged and blocked. Added those IPs to watchlist.

tara: Action items recap:
- revoke token + delete old SA key (ops-oncall) — done
- new scoped SA key in Vault (ops-oncall) — done
- rewrap/rotate transit key (oliver) — in progress
- RBAC scoping PR (ben) — merged
- enable Vault/GCP audit sinks (ben) — done
- change bucket lifecycle to 24h & block org-editors (ops-oncall) — done

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-999 updated: timeline + owners linked.

oliver: Rewrap finished for objects using transit-KMS-21. Ticket created to rotate transit-KMS-21 in next maintenance window (ETA 6h).

ben: Scheduling a 45m blameless postmortem tomorrow 11:00 PT to discuss agent hardening: default scrub env vars, reject uploads containing "VAULT_TOKEN" or "private_key", and lower default TTLs.

tara: I'll invite infra, devex, and security. Adding remediation checklist to the incident and closing this thread for now. :white_check_mark:
